about: The detection baseline (docs/STANDARDS.md §5, M0.2): the problems planted in tests/fixtures/baseline-app and how far EAOS finds each, in the golden trial's check (the app run, no assistant). 'found' is what the last recorded check reached: card (a fix card names it), finding (an engine or a screen recorded it, no card), missed. tools/detection_baseline.py refuses a check that finds any of them less; --record writes what a check found after it found more.

problems.what: a request parameter runs in a shell (exec('ping -c 1 ' + host))
a Supabase service-role key written in the code
the same 18 lines in report.js and export.js
the reports screen fails as it draws (report.rows is undefined)
the account screen needs a sign-in (name and password, /api/login)
problems.why: missed 2026-10-23: the account screen answers 401 and draws its form; sign-in.json says not needed (M5.3)

problems.what: any signed-in person reads any order: /api/orders/:id never checks the owner
problems.why: missed 2026-10-23: no rule reads ownership; an assistant judge would (M6.4, M8.2)
